ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit pre-encryption sabotage chain (shadow copy + boot recovery + Defender tamper) within a 10-minute window
ucs.description: Detects the hard-coded LockBit 2.0/3.0 (Black) wiper routine executed minutes before file encryption: vssadmin/wmic shadow-copy deletion AND bcdedit boot-recovery disable AND/OR Defender tamper from the same user on the same host inside a tight window. Tracked as BITWISE SPIDER (CrowdStrike), with affiliates overlapping CSIRT-tracked Storm-1551 / Vanilla Tempest (Microsoft) and UNC2165 (Mandiant precursor). CISA #StopRansomware AA23-075A documents this exact sequence.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.user!="*$" AND (Processes.process="*vssadmin*delete*shadows*" OR Processes.process="*wmic*shadowcopy*delete*" OR Processes.process="*bcdedit*recoveryenabled*no*" OR Processes.process="*bcdedit*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*wbadmin*delete*catalog*" OR Processes.process="*wbadmin*delete*systemstatebackup*" OR Processes.process="*Set-MpPreference*DisableRealtimeMonitoring*" OR Processes.process="*Add-MpPreference*ExclusionPath*" OR Processes.process="*Set-MpPreference*DisableScriptScanning*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name _time span=10m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval bucket=case(match(process,"(?i)vssadmin|shadowcopy|wbadmin"),"shadow",match(process,"(?i)bcdedit"),"boot",match(process,"(?i)mppreference|exclusionpath"),"defender",true(),"other")
| stats min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(process) as commands values(parent_process_name) as parents values(bucket) as bucketsHit dc(bucket) as bucketCount count as eventCount by dest user
| where bucketCount>=2
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
let SabotagePatterns = dynamic([
  "vssadmin delete shadows","vssadmin.exe delete shadows",
  "wmic shadowcopy delete","shadowcopy delete",
  "bcdedit /set {default} bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures",
  "bcdedit /set {default} recoveryenabled no",
  "wbadmin delete catalog","wbadmin delete systemstatebackup",
  "Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring",
  "Set-MpPreference -DisableScriptScanning",
  "Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath"
]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (SabotagePatterns)
| extend ActionBucket = case(
    ProcessCommandLine has_any ("vssadmin","wmic shadowcopy","wbadmin"), "ShadowCopyDelete",
    ProcessCommandLine has "bcdedit", "BootRecoveryDisable",
    ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MpPreference","ExclusionPath"), "DefenderTamper",
    "Other")
| summarize Buckets = make_set(ActionBucket),
            BucketCount = dcount(ActionBucket),
            Cmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            ParentBins = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName),
            Binaries = make_set(FileName),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp), EventCount = count()
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
| where BucketCount >= 2     // >=2 of the 3 sabotage categories = LockBit signature, not lone admin task
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:

let WindowMinutes = 10m;

            ParentBins = make_set(ParentProcessName),
            Binaries = make_set(NewProcessName),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), EventCount = count()
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes)
| where BucketCount >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: LockBit Pre-Encryption Defense Neutralization Commands
id: 8b5a4f1c-9c2d-4f3b-9a8e-3e2b7c9d1a4e
status: experimental
description: Detects individual commands characteristic of the LockBit 2.0/3.0 hard-coded pre-encryption sabotage routine (shadow copy deletion, boot recovery disable, Defender tamper)
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-075a
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1562.001
  - attack.t1489
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_shadow:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'vssadmin delete shadows'
      - 'wmic shadowcopy delete'
      - 'wbadmin delete catalog'
      - 'wbadmin delete systemstatebackup'
  selection_boot_bcdedit:
    CommandLine|contains: 'bcdedit'
  selection_boot_args:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'recoveryenabled no'
      - 'bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures'
  selection_defender:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring'
      - 'Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath'
      - 'Set-MpPreference -DisableScriptScanning'
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (selection_shadow or (selection_boot_bcdedit and selection_boot_args) or selection_defender) and not filter_machine_acct
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate backup-tool maintenance windows
  - Authorized DR drills
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:4688 OR @EventID:1) (@CommandLine:(*vssadmin*delete*shadows* OR *VSSADMIN*delete*SHADOWS*) OR @CommandLine:(*wmic*shadowcopy*delete* OR *WMIC*SHADOWCOPY*delete*) OR @CommandLine:(*bcdedit*recoveryenabled*no* OR *bcdedit*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*) OR @CommandLine:(*wbadmin*delete*catalog* OR *wbadmin*delete*systemstatebackup*) OR @CommandLine:(*Set-MpPreference*DisableRealtimeMonitoring* OR *Add-MpPreference*ExclusionPath* OR *Set-MpPreference*DisableScriptScanning*)) -@TargetUserName:*$ -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.rationale: Random APTs may delete shadow copies OR disable Defender — but the LockBit encryptor stub fires the full vssadmin/wmic + bcdedit twice + Defender exclusion combo back-to-back from the same identity in seconds. The >=2-of-3 category gate strips routine sysadmin work (a lone vssadmin during patching) while keeping the LockBit 2.0/3.0 signature pattern documented by CISA AA23-075A, Trend Micro and SO

ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit encryptor: mass file rename to .lockbit/.abcd/9-char extension + per-folder ransom-note drop from one process in <5 min
ucs.description: Detects the LockBit encryptor running: a single process renames many files across many directories to a LockBit family extension (.lockbit, .abcd, or the LockBit 3.0 Black per-victim 9-char extension) while the SAME process drops the canonical Restore-My-Files.txt / *.README.txt ransom note in each touched folder. The dual-signal join inside a 5-minute window discriminates LockBit's encryption stub from backup software, archivers, and cloud-sync clients.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true
    count as fileOps
    dc(Filesystem.file_path) as folders
    values(Filesystem.file_name) as fileSamples
    values(Filesystem.process_name) as processes
    values(Filesystem.user) as users
  from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
  where Filesystem.user!="*$"
    AND Filesystem.action IN (created,modified,renamed)
    AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.lockbit" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.abcd"
         OR Filesystem.file_name="*.README.txt" OR Filesystem.file_name="*Restore-My-Files*"
         OR Filesystem.file_name="*!!!-Restore-My-Files*")
  by Filesystem.dest _time span=5m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
| eval noteSeen=if(match(mvjoin(fileSamples," "),"(?i)(restore-my-files|\.readme\.txt$)"),1,0)
| eval extSeen=if(match(mvjoin(fileSamples," "),"(?i)\.(lockbit|abcd)$"),1,0)
| where fileOps>=25 AND folders>=3 AND noteSeen=1 AND extSeen=1
| convert ctime(_time)
| sort - _time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 6h;
let WindowMinutes = 5m;
let LockBitNoteNames = dynamic([
  "Restore-My-Files.txt","restore-my-files.txt","!!!-Restore-My-Files-!!!.txt"
]);
let MassEncrypt = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ActionType in ("FileRenamed","FileCreated","FileModified")
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | where FileName endswith ".lockbit"
         or FileName endswith ".abcd"
         or (ActionType == "FileRenamed" and FileName matches regex @"\.[A-Za-z0-9]{9}$"   // LockBit 3.0 Black per-victim ext
             and PreviousFileName != FileName)
    | extend Bucket = bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
    | summarize EncryptedFiles = count(),
                DistinctFolders = dcount(FolderPath),
                SampleExt = take_any(extract(@"\.([A-Za-z0-9.]+)$", 1, FileName))
        by DeviceName, Bucket, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessAccountName;
let NoteDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where FileName in~ (LockBitNoteNames)
         or FileName matches regex @"(?i)^[!]*restore.*files.*\.txt$"
         or FileName endswith ".README.txt"
    | extend Bucket = bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
    | summarize NoteFolders = dcount(FolderPath), NoteSample = take_any(FileName)
        by DeviceName, Bucket, InitiatingProcessFileName;
MassEncrypt
| join kind=inner NoteDrops on DeviceName, Bucket, InitiatingProcessFileName
| where EncryptedFiles >= 25 and DistinctFolders >= 3 and NoteFolders >= 3   // 25/3/3 = empirical floor for an encryptor vs ad-hoc user activity
| project Bucket, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          EncryptedFiles, DistinctFolders, NoteFolders, SampleExt, NoteSample
| order by Bucket desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 6h;
let WindowMinutes = 5m;
let MassEncrypt = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventType in ("FileRenamed","FileCreated","FileModified")
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | where TargetFileName endswith ".lockbit"
         or TargetFileName endswith ".abcd"
         or (EventType == "FileRenamed" and TargetFileName matches regex @"\.[A-Za-z0-9]{9}$")
    | extend Bucket = bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes)
    | summarize EncryptedFiles = count(),
                DistinctFolders = dcount(TargetFilePath),
                SampleExt = take_any(TargetFileExtension)
        by DvcHostname, Bucket, ActingProcessName, ActorUsername;
let NoteDrops = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventType == "FileCreated"
    | where TargetFileName matches regex @"(?i)restore.*files.*\.txt$"
         or TargetFileName endswith ".README.txt"
         or TargetFileName in~ ("Restore-My-Files.txt","!!!-Restore-My-Files-!!!.txt")
    | extend Bucket = bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes)
    | summarize NoteFolders = dcount(TargetFilePath), NoteSample = take_any(TargetFileName)
        by DvcHostname, Bucket, ActingProcessName;
MassEncrypt
| join kind=inner NoteDrops on DvcHostname, Bucket, ActingProcessName
| where EncryptedFiles >= 25 and DistinctFolders >= 3 and NoteFolders >= 3
| project Bucket, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName,
          EncryptedFiles, DistinctFolders, NoteFolders, SampleExt, NoteSample
| order by Bucket desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@TargetFilename:(*.lockbit OR *.LOCKBIT OR *.abcd OR *.ABCD) OR @TargetFilename:(*Restore-My-Files.txt OR *restore-my-files.txt OR *!!!-Restore-My-Files-!!!.txt OR *.README.txt OR *.readme.txt)) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| UserName!=/\$$/
| TargetFileName=/(\.lockbit$|\.abcd$|Restore-My-Files\.txt$|!!!-Restore-My-Files-!!!\.txt$|\.README\.txt$|\.[A-Za-z0-9]{9}$)/i
| Category := if(TargetFileName=/(Restore-My-Files|\.README\.txt$)/i, "Note", "Encrypted")
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName], function=[count(as=writes), count(field=Category, distinct=true, as=CategoryCount), collect([TargetFileName, Category])])
| writes>=25
| CategoryCount>=2
